text.p: Italian debt instruments showed an uncertain trend in early trading, moving between negative and positive territory as the market attempted to consolidate after late Thursday's sharp sell-off, dealers said.

They added that futures started lower and then oscilated between showing small gains and losses in early trade, but they added that the market was likely to be cautious ahead of U.S. non-farm payroll figures for July due later today.
"After Thursday's sharp sell-off the market looks a little nervous but it is unlikely to do much ahead of the U.S. jobs numbers," one dealer on the LIFFE market said.
Dealers added that the BTP market took some early support from higher overnight T-bonds and the firm lira against the mark, although the Italian currency was weaker against the dollar.
